_comment: Counterparty -> category for the owner's personal SBI account.
Matching is on the UPI/NEFT remark, which carries the payee's short name and
VPA. Match on the VPA or the bank code where possible: the short name is
truncated to 8 characters by the bank and two different people can collide.
RULE: never invent a category for a counterparty you cannot identify. An
unmatched payee lands in 'unknown' with its remark intact, exactly like
untraced money in the income tally. A wrong label on a spending summary is
worse than an honest gap, because the owner acts on these numbers.

salary.label: Salary
salary.note: Zluri Technologies, the owner's employer. Paid by IMPS or NEFT.

rent.label: Rent
rent.note: Paid to Satyam. Some months carry the literal word 'Rent' in the remark.

to_mummy.label: To mummy
to_mummy.note: Seema Bakliwal, the owner's mother, at Punjab National Bank (PUNB). This is the same account the yt-income tally reads, so money leaving here arrives there — see pipelines/income-analysis.

credit_card.label: Credit card
credit_card.note: CRED. A card bill is a payment for spending that already happened, so it double-counts against the categories below if both are summed as 'spending'.

education.label: BITS fees
education.note: Paid to Shirish, remark says 'Bits'. The owner studies at BITS Pilani Goa.
